s.note: Smoky pulled chicken under creamy coleslaw. Rob crowns himself coleslaw king.
s.how: Rub the chicken with paprika and salt and pan-fry until cooked through. Shred with two forks and toss with the barbecue sauce. Toss both cabbages and the carrot with the mayo and vinegar. Fill the rolls with chicken and a big pile of slaw.

s.note: Cornmeal-battered mini franks with mustard. She's not Josie Grossie anymore.
s.how: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then the egg and milk, to a thick batter. Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each. Dip in the batter and fry at 180C until deep golden. Drain and serve hot with mustard.

m.note: Chicago deep dish with sausage and mozzarella. Rigfort sends her undercover.
m.how: Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano and salt until thick. Oil a deep 25cm cake tin and press the dough up the sides. Layer the mozzarella on the base, then pinches of sausage, then the sauce, and finish with parmesan. Bake at 220C on the lowest shelf until the crust is golden and the filling bubbles.

m.note: Sticky pork ribs with charred corn. Aldys sizes up the fire in a trash can.
m.how: Rub the ribs with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C until tender. Mix the barbecue sauce with the honey, brush over the ribs and grill hot until sticky and charred. Char the corn on the grill, brush with butter and serve with the ribs.

w.note: Lattice cherry pie with vanilla ice cream. She can't work out who ate it.
w.how: Line a pie dish with one sheet of pastry. Toss the cherries with the sugar, cornflour and lemon zest and pile in. Cut the second sheet into strips, weave a lattice over the top and brush with egg. Bake at 190C until golden and bubbling, then rest. Serve warm with ice cream.
shop: 2 x 680g jars pitted morello cherries, drained@Pantry

d.note: Raspberry pink lemonade with mint over ice. The crown gets thrown away.
d.how: Simmer the raspberries, sugar and water until syrupy, then strain and cool. Squeeze the lemons into a jug with the syrup. Fill glasses with ice and mint, pour in the pink base and top with soda.

shopping: 2 x 680g jars pitted morello cherries, drained@Pantry
